result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: a stray black bar overlapping the bottom navigation icons, a missing title/metadata block for the second 'Popular right now' card, clipped text in the horizontal carousel, and inconsistent styling of favorite buttons and card thumbnails.

issues.description: A solid black horizontal bar runs across the bottom navigation bar, overlapping and obscuring the middle (search/bookmark) tab icons, making them unreadable and likely untappable.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray element (likely a mis-sized divider, home indicator, or active-tab indicator) so it sits above/below the tab icons and does not cover them.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card ends abruptly at the image.
issues.suggestion: Render the title/rating/meta block for every restaurant card, or ensure enough scroll padding so the info row is not clipped by the bottom nav.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items have icon-only representation with no text labels, and the obscured middle item gives no indication of its purpose or active state.
issues.suggestion: Add visible text labels and accessible names/aria-labels for each tab, plus a clear active-state indicator.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol…') with the image and price also clipped by the screen edge, and it is unclear it is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal padding/peek width so partially visible cards look intentional, and truncate labels with an ellipsis rather than a hard clip.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card, dark/transparent background on the pizza card, reducing visibility against light imagery.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment (e.g. white or scrim-backed circle) for all favorite toggles.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments are inconsistent — the Green Bowl Poké image sits on a light grey background while the other cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image aspect ratio, background and overlay treatment across all cards.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving the impression of a broken layout.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and a visible scroll affordance (fade or arrow) to indicate more categories exist.
